lean.statement: ∀ (E V : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (s : Set E) (f g : E → V) (c : ℝ → E) (t₀ : ℝ) (v : E), DifferentiableAt ℝ f (c t₀) → DifferentiableAt ℝ g (c t₀) → HasDerivAt c v t₀ → (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 t₀, c t ∈ s) → (f =ᶠ[𝓝[s] (c t₀)] g) → fderiv ℝ f (c t₀) v = fderiv ℝ g (c t₀) v
approved_definition_context: DifferentiableAt ℝ f x means a genuine Fréchet derivative exists at x. fderiv ℝ f x is that actual bounded real-linear map when the function is differentiable there.
HasDerivAt c v t means that c has genuine one-parameter derivative v at t.
𝓝 t is the neighborhood filter at t. 𝓝[s] x is the filter of neighborhoods of x relative to s. EventuallyEq means equality holds on a set belonging to the indicated filter.
∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 t₀, P t means that P holds for all t sufficiently near t₀.
